easyPrerequisites: There are applicable target(s) for Snap.
description:
Cast Snap by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Snap, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Snap copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and untapping up to two lands you control.
Repeat from step 2.
